report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all sampled checkout flows returning HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders with 200s and zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. The deployment record only proves version 1.0.0 with no prior version. No checkout error evidence exists, so no bounded cause can be established.
missing_evidence: Error-level logs or traces showing actual checkout failures (order logs were excluded from context)
Metrics or traces with non-2xx status on /v1/checkout or /v1/orders during the incident window
Deployment timeline correlating any version change with error onset
Evidence of the specific failure mode (5xx, pool exhaustion, redis timeout, latency) to bound a cause
